observations.body: HR Admin dashboard for Hannah shows 25 days leave balance, zero pending leave requests, zero approvals waiting and 28 employees. Navigation includes Dashboard, Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, Approvals, Onboarding and My Profile. Quick actions include Request leave, Fill timesheet, Review approvals and Add new hire.
The Add new hire quick action links to /onboarding, the Onboarding Surface.
Clicking Add new hire from the Dashboard reached /onboarding/step-1, the first New hire onboarding step.

New hire onboarding opens at Step 1, Personal information, in a four-step flow: Personal, Job details, Equipment and Review. First name, Last name and Company email are marked required; Phone has no asterisk. A Next button is shown. All four fields are initially empty.
Submitting Next with all fields empty kept the wizard on Step 1 and displayed field validation messages.
Submitting Next with First name empty displayed 'First name is required.'
Submitting Next with Last name empty displayed 'Last name is required.'
Submitting Next with Company email empty displayed 'A valid email address is required.'

After filling First name with Synthetic, its textbox showed Synthetic, but the earlier 'First name is required.' message remained visible; the Last name and Company email validation messages also remained while those fields were empty.

Filling Last name with Trial left the 'Last name is required.' message visible; the textbox showed Trial, First name showed Synthetic, and the Company email validation message remained while Email was empty.

Filling Company email with synthetic.trial.20261013@bugbusters.io displayed that value in the textbox; the earlier 'A valid email address is required.' message remained visible. The first and last name values remained Synthetic and Trial with their earlier required messages visible.
First name is Synthetic, Last name is Trial, and Company email is synthetic.trial.20261013@bugbusters.io. Phone is blank. The previous inline errors are still visible.
Submitting Step 1 with Synthetic Trial and the valid synthetic email advanced to Step 2, Job details. Phone was blank; the wizard accepted it for this transition.

Step 2, Job details, shows required Department, Job title and Start date fields. Manager is optional and defaults to No manager. Department choices are Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR; manager choices are Hannah Blake (HR), Julia Romero (Sales), Laura Kim (Marketing), Michael Reed (Engineering) and Samuel Turner (Finance). Back and Next buttons are present.
On Step 2, selecting Engineering set the Department field to Engineering; Job title and Start date remained empty, and Manager remained No manager.
On Step 2, Job title showed Synthetic Trial Role after filling it; Department remained Engineering, Start date was empty, and Manager remained No manager.
On Step 2, Start date showed 2026-11-02 after filling it; Department remained Engineering, Job title remained Synthetic Trial Role, and Manager remained No manager.
Department is Engineering, Job title is Synthetic Trial Role, Start date is 2026-11-02, and Manager is No manager. The current step has a Next button.
Next from Job details advanced the onboarding wizard to Step 3, Equipment.

Step 3, Equipment, offers required Laptop choices MacBook Pro 14" and ThinkPad X1 Carbon; neither radio appears selected. Include welcome kit (t-shirt, mug, stickers) is checked. Back and Next buttons are shown.
Selecting ThinkPad X1 Carbon marked that laptop radio checked. The welcome kit checkbox remained checked.
ThinkPad X1 Carbon is selected, welcome kit remains checked, and Step 3 shows Next.

Next from Equipment advanced to Step 4, Review & confirm. The summary showed Synthetic Trial, synthetic.trial.20261013@bugbusters.io, no phone, Engineering, Synthetic Trial Role, 2026-11-02 and ThinkPad X1.

Step 4, Review & confirm, summarizes name, email, phone as �, department, job title, start date and equipment. Back and Create employee buttons are shown. The summary does not show the welcome kit selection.

Review & confirm shows Synthetic Trial, synthetic.trial.20261013@bugbusters.io, no phone, Engineering, Synthetic Trial Role, start date 2026-11-02 and ThinkPad X1. The synthetic record is ready to create once.

After clicking Create employee, the immediate capture showed the Step 4 review screen with Create employee disabled as Creating� while the request was pending. The settled state moved to /onboarding/done and displayed Welcome aboard, Synthetic Trial! and The new employee has been added to the directory.
Create employee reached the Onboarding confirmation page at /onboarding/done, which confirmed the new employee was added.
Onboarding confirmation displays Welcome aboard, Synthetic Trial! and says the new employee has been added to the directory. It offers View directory and Add another links.
Selecting View directory returned to /directory, which showed 29 employees on page 1 of 3.
View directory reached the Employee directory Surface.

Columns are Name (ascending), Department, Title and Email; search and department filter are available with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR. Previous is disabled and Next is enabled. The visible top ten are the original alphabetically early entries; the new Synthetic Trial row is not on this page. No direct Add employee control is shown.
Searching the directory with synthetic.trial.20261013@bugbusters.io returned 0 employees and displayed No employees found.
Search the directory for the created synthetic employee by name, Synthetic Trial, to check whether the record created in onboarding is available in directory search.

The accepted attempt to search by name did not execute: the browser bridge dispatched the prior email query instead, and the settled capture still shows the email query with 0 employees. The attempted name query is not established; do not replay this check.

observations.body: The directory still has the email query applied and shows no employees. Clear the query so the paged directory can be inspected.
Clearing the search restored all 29 employees on page 1 of 3; the empty Search by name field, department filter, Next button, and disabled Previous button are visible.
All 29 employees are shown on page 1 of 3, with no search or department filter applied. Next is enabled.
Clicking Next changed the directory from page 1 to page 2 of 3; 29 employees remain in the directory and both Previous and Next are enabled.
The directory is on page 2 of 3, search and department filters are clear, 29 employees remain, and Next is enabled. Advance to page 3 to inspect the remaining records.

On page 3, the first row identifies Synthetic Trial in Engineering as Synthetic Trial Role with the trial email. Open this employee row to inspect the employee detail surface.

Opening the Synthetic Trial row reached the Employee details Surface at /employees/29.

look.reason: The browser action file supplied to the bridge contained the previous email-search action instead of the accepted name-search action, so the name query was not dispatched.

repeat.reason: The previous accepted name-search attempt is reconciled as not executed; its immediate and settled captures show the distinct previous email query was dispatched instead.

look.reason: The search field does not exist on the Employee details page currently shown at /employees/29; the bridge timed out before entering the query.

The Employee directory is on page 1 with 28 employees. Search, department filter and pagination controls are shown; no Add employee control is shown.

Selecting Previous from page 2 returned the directory to page 1 of 3 with 28 employees; Previous is disabled and Next is enabled.

Employee details for Emily Dawson shows title Software Engineer, department Engineering, email emily.dawson@bugbusters.io, phone 555-0107, manager Michael Reed and start date Nov 1, 2021. A Back to directory link is available.
